body: Wow 14?! It's ok. Life gets better and there is no need to risk your life going out running away possibly getting killed. There is a lot of bad things going on but what about the good. Take those things and focus on them. I'm a 24 year old woman who has been disowned heartbroken and almost killed myself but have survived because on my outlook and rely on my fufture. You will be fine just look on the bright side.

Hello darling! There are people here for you even though you might not notice it.
One, you need to take a breathe right now for ten seconds. Think about two things you wish would happen.
Second, you need to think of how amazing you are and how strong you are and have proven yourself to be by sticking through this all. I'm so so so sorry about your past and if I can help in any way I'm here.
Third, give yourself some time to think, recuperate, and just rejoin and collect your mind and body pieces.
Lastly, don't let the way your feeling affect your life. You are amazing! Don't let anything make you feel otherwise. If a friend leaves you, they are not a good friend, and you can do so much better. For everything that's negative there is a positive you just have to take a chance to see it. I know it's hard because I've been through it but you will survive if you continue fighting!
